info.title: Realtime Sports API
info.description:
Live scores, play-by-play, box scores, schedules, teams, athletes, injuries, news and betting odds
for NFL, college football, NBA, men's college basketball, MLB, NHL and 23 soccer competitions, under one
schema and one API key. Push delivery is available over webhooks and WebSocket.

**Freshness:** data is aggregated from public sources and is typically 20-30 seconds behind live play
(our pipeline adds about 1 second after our source). Not suitable for in-play betting that needs
sub-second data. There is no SLA.

**Auth:** send `Authorization: Bearer <api key>` (or `X-API-Key: <api key>`). Get a free key at
https://www.realtimesportsapi.com/signup?utm_source=openapi.

**Quotas:** monthly call quotas per plan (Free 125/month, 1,000 in the first 30 days; Starter 10,000;
Growth 25,000; Pro 50,000; Scale 500,000). Every successful REST call counts as one call. When the quota is
exhausted the API returns HTTP 429 with a `Retry-After` header. Per-second rates also apply
(Free 1/s, Starter 5/s, Growth 10/s, Pro 20/s, Scale 100/s). Remaining monthly quota is reported in
`meta.rateLimit` on most responses.

post.description: Returns the WebSocket URL and a token valid for one hour. Connect to `${url}?token=${token}`, then send `{"type":"subscribe","event":"event_score_change","filters":{"sport":"football","league":"nfl"}}`. Event types: event_score_change, event_live, event_status_change, event_play, event_final, event_odds_change. Each delivered message counts toward your quota.

401.description: Missing or invalid API key (UNAUTHORIZED, INVALID_API_KEY).

403.description: Subscription inactive or monthly quota exhausted (SUBSCRIPTION_INACTIVE, WEBSOCKET_QUOTA_EXCEEDED).

BearerAuth.description: Your API key from the dashboard: `Authorization: Bearer <api key>`. Keys are opaque strings, not JWTs.

ApiKeyHeader.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyHeader.description: Alternative to the Authorization header (useful behind proxies that strip Authorization).

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, unknown or expired API key (codes: MISSING_TOKEN, USER_NOT_FOUND, TRIAL_EXPIRED).

RateLimitExceeded.description: Too many requests: either the monthly quota is exhausted (code RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED; upgrade or enable overage) or the plan's per-second rate was exceeded (code RATE_LIMIT_PER_SECOND; Free 1/s, Starter 5/s, Growth 10/s, Pro 20/s, Scale 100/s). Wait for `Retry-After` seconds.

ServerError.description: Unexpected error. Safe to retry with backoff.

remaining.description: Calls remaining this month (approximate; updated asynchronously).

reset.description: Quota reset time, Unix epoch milliseconds.

pageCount.description: Present on some endpoints instead of totalPages.

InningState.description: MLB only; absent for other leagues and before first pitch. half, the count and the runner flags are set while the game is live and null otherwise.

PracticeParticipation.description: Practice participation parsed from the latest news note. Derived, not an official injury-report field; absent when the note does not state it.
